description: Executable Candidate legacy single-Spark profile for the exact NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano NVFP4 checkpoint. It remains installable for reproducibility, but Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is the preferred default for new text deployments. The immutable snapshot supplies the reviewed nano_v3 reasoning plugin, while FP8 KV and FlashInfer NVFP4 MoE follow NVIDIA's launch contract. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark (superseded)
